title: Crash windows
objective: Injected worker crashes must be reconciled by machine: each execution.crash opens a crash window that closes only when a machine-caused reconcile resumes execution and the iteration still reaches receipt.persist. CRR = reconciled crash windows / crash windows must be 1.0 and RR must be 1.0.

scenario_identity.identity_rule: sha256 over the canonical manifest bytes; per-trial corpus identity pinned by MANIFEST.json sha256

setup.crash_window: execution.crash -> (reconcile -> execution.start on a fresh WorkerRun -> ... -> receipt.persist) closes the window
setup.placement: crashes at iterations 15, 30, 50, 65, 85; all other iterations clean

acceptance_criteria: court verdict QUALIFIED with episode class AUTONOMOUS
CRR == 1.0 (every crash window closed by a machine reconcile)
falsifier: Remove one reconcile event so one crash window is closed only by a bare re-execution: CRR must drop below 1.0 and the scenario must FAIL. If the window still counts as reconciled, CRR is vacuous.

negative_control.name: unrecovered crash
negative_control.requirement: a crash with no machine recovery path must fail the scenario

status_note: Synthetic crash injection; measures recovery-accounting semantics, not real crash handling.
